coverage_assessment: First-pass open-web research used 24 captured Albanian- and English-language search invocations with 668 ordered result headers across January weekly windows, sector and regional searches, and December/February boundaries. Five event candidates remain provisional because no verified individual attendance count establishes 50 people. In particular, Shëngjin’s 131 is workforce size and a separate search-only “about 130” estimate has an unavailable body; memorial relatives and affected households are not crowd counts. Local archive and LexisNexis coverage is unavailable. Exact-URL access outcomes, dates, event demands, continuity, and response gaps remain preserved.
